name and environment labels before promotion to production.", "output": "Our distributed tracing infrastructure is overwhelming OpenTelemetry collector nodes during high throughput service load. Please inspect `sampler.ts` in the telemetry directory and check `trace_pipeline.yaml` in the collector configuration folder. Our microservices emit W3C trace context headers across hundreds of RPC service boundaries. Under sustained traffic loads, trace ingestion volume causes memory exhaustion in collector pods, dropping valid diagnostic traces. Furthermore, ensure that `sampler.ts` always samples requests that return HTTP 500-series errors regardless of baseline sample probabilities. To reduce network egress costs, collectors must compress exported span payloads using Zstandard compression level 3 before streaming to remote storage. The observability lead mandates enforcing semantic conventions for database query attributes, redacting all SQL parameter values from database client spans. If an upstream collector agent crashes, the local OpenTelemetry SDK buffer in `tracer_buffer.ts` must buffer up to 5000 spans in memory before dropping telemetry data. In addition, trace processing workers must compute p95 and p99 trace duration metrics across 1-minute sliding windows exporting latency percentiles to Prometheus. To maintain trace context propagation across asynchronous message brokers, Kafka producers in `event_producer.py` must inject traceparent headers into all record metadata headers. When distributed services execute database transactions, the Postgres client driver must extract trace identifiers and tag query comments with span context for cross-tier query attribution. System administrators must configure OpenTelemetry collector pods with 4 GB memory limits and 2 virtual CPUs, ensuring collector buffers do not experience CPU throttling. The network operations center monitors dropped span ratios on the secondary Grafana dashboard, raising critical alerts when span loss exceeds 0.2% of total emitted telemetry. Additionally, all exported telemetry streams must route through internal private network endpoints, avoiding public internet transit across multi-region cloud deployments. Observability engineers must also configure Prometheus alert rules in `alerts.yaml` to trigger on-call pages when collector queue utilization exceeds 80% across two consecutive polling intervals. Finally, the platform team mandates that all microservices pass automated telemetry integration tests verifying that trace spans contain valid service name and environment labels before promotion to production."}]
